correctness.rationale: A face iff each selected pair is disjoint from at most one other selected pair; exhaustive independent implementation checked 32767 nonempty masks and found 746 faces with f=(15,105,260,255,96,15). The pivot-toggle matching independently yields 370 matched pairs, six critical masks [1,5664,10784,19488,28736,29184], 2580 Hasse incidences and acyclic orientation visiting all 746 faces. Forman Morse theory gives CW model with one 0-cell and five 3-cells attached to a point, hence a wedge of five 3-spheres over Z. This verifies the complete finite case, not by extrapolating ranks.

limitations: Specific n=6 ordinary homotopy; no new equivariant statement or larger-n classification.
